projectDescription: A retro Windows 98-style personal portfolio built with React, featuring a fully interactive desktop environment with draggable/resizable windows, a Start menu, taskbar, and themed app windows for showcasing developer work.
keyFeatures: Windows 98-style desktop environment rendered entirely in React
Draggable, resizable, minimizable, and maximizable windows using Framer Motion
Start menu with app launcher and 'Shut Down' button
Taskbar with live clock, active window buttons, and minimize/restore support
CRT scanline and flicker overlay for authentic retro feel
Animated visitor counter with LED-style digit display
Nine themed app windows: Home, About, Projects, Skills, Work History, Case Studies, Blog, Contact (Guestbook), and Testimonials
Pixel fonts (Pixelify Sans, VT323) and Win98 CSS border utilities
Built with Vite + React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
publicApiSurface: WindowProvider — context provider wrapping the entire app
useWindows() — hook: { windows, openWindow, closeWindow, minimizeWindow, maximizeWindow, restoreWindow, focusWindow, activeWindowId }
openWindow(id, title, component, icon, { width, height, defaultX, defaultY })
apps[] — array of app config objects in config/apps.js: { id, title, icon, component, width, height }
Desktop component — renders desktop icons, open windows, visitor counter, taskbar, and CRT overlay
Window component — renders a single managed window with title bar controls
Taskbar component — renders Start button, window buttons, and system clock
.win-border-outset / .win-border-inset / .win-border-window — CSS utility classes for Win98 border effect
.crt-overlay / .crt-flicker — CSS classes for CRT screen effect
